title: Celebrate Discord’s 11th Birthday with an Exclusive Set of Emoji and Wallpapers
summary: Discord is turning 11 this year! To celebrate, we made over twenty Discord-themed emojis, along with over twenty wallpapers, and even a digital poster for everyone to download, for free!
body:
Aaah, 2015. There were some incredible games that came out that year, like The Witcher 3, Metal Gear Solid V, Rocket League, and a little indie game called… Undertale. It’s pretty niche, idk if you’ve heard of that one before. 

But how were people talking about and playing these games together? With a cool new app that had just been released to the world called… Discord. Yep, as of today, Discord is now ELEVEN years old! 

To celebrate, we made over twenty Discord-themed emojis, along with over twenty desktop and mobile wallpapers, and even a digital poster for everyone to download, for free! 

Put all these snazzy Discord-made emoji in one of your servers for you and all your friends to use, or pick your favorite wallpaper and set it as your background. Or use it as your profile or server banner! Or your fridge, next to all of your beautiful(?) crayon doodles.

Picked out a server to upload your new favorite emoji? Good. Use the button below to download all the emoji, wallpapers, and poster: 

Download Special Discord Emojis, Wallpapers

If you’ve never uploaded emoji to Discord before and aren’t sure how, we got you. It’s so easy, you’ll be uploading emoji a LOT more after today. 

We won’t keep you forever. Go upload those emoji and stickers, set a new wallpaper, then hop back into the VC you were just hanging in and show off all the new emoji that you uploaded to share with all your server friends! 

Or, if you’ve already used all of your server’s emoji slots, we’ll have ‘em on our official Discord Town Hall server for you to try out (which you should join anyways, we’d love to have you):

Join Discord Town Hall

If you really love all the new artwork and wish you could collect it all in the real world, keep an eye out on our social pages (such as X or Instagram). During our birthday month, you may see these gorgeous pieces of art taking more forms… physical forms? Maybe. Who knows what’s in the cards…?
